scope: Candidate-result dispatch inside the client object loader, not the full cache, retry loop or engine loader.

instruction_anchors.meaning: Five model-open stack arguments followed by virtual call at +0x74
Map results 0x80000001 through 0x80000014 into a 20-entry switch; others go to signed check
Byte selector table followed by absolute target table
Signed nonnegative results enter success handling at 006ce57f
Increment candidate index, compare against count, retry at 006ce3db only if candidates remain

reconstruction.rule: High bit clear accepts the candidate result. 0x80000002 and 0x8000000a stop with failure. Other negative results request the next candidate, with the two observed diagnostics reported separately.
intentional_differences: A pure decision object replaces inline control flow and logging; callers must consume both the action and diagnostic.
Unsigned 32-bit result bits avoid implementation-defined unsigned-to-signed conversion.
No SDK names are invented for unexplained result codes.
Try-next describes the branch, not a guarantee that a further candidate exists.

limitations: No original code execution, complete cache policy, ownership/refcounts, candidate construction, logging implementation, resource search directories or successful model loading.
